fullContentHtml:
SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Answer Key for the SSC Constable GD in BSF, CISF, ITBP, CRPF, NCB, SSF, Assam Rifles on the official website of the SSC after evaluating candidates’ performance in the examination. This recruitment was conducted for 25,487 posts. Applications for the SSC GD Constable Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 01 December 2025 to 31 December 2025. The examination was held from 0=27 April 2026 to 30 May 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 01 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 01 December 2025
  • Last Date : 31 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 January 2026
  • Last Date Correction : 10-13 January 2026
  • Prelim Exam Date : 23 February 2026 (Postponed)
  • New Exam Date : 27 April to 30 May 2026
  • Choose Exam Week Preference : 11-15 April 2026
  • Exam City Details : 19 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 24 April 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 15 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC  : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Female Candidates : 0/-
  • Correction Charge
  • First Time : Rs. 200/-
  • Second Time : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
